title: Resilient-capacity first-run visualization and tooltip library
creator: Anya Patel
description: Design and deliver a cohesive set of visuals and micro-interactions for the Dedicated first-run experience focusing on resilient capacity. Deliverables: hero illustration set (3 variants), stage-based capacity storyboard (Provisioning, Warmup, Ramp, Steady, Failover), contextual tooltip library explaining autoscale knobs and SLA trade-offs, and a responsive screenshot suite for Console v2. Goal is to reduce onboarding time and preempt common capacity mistakes by surfacing clear trade-offs (latency vs cost vs availability).
comments: 2025-02-12 - Anya: Initial moodboard + three illustration directions uploaded to Figma. Directions: 1) Schematic rigs + devices, 2) Friendly isometric datacenter, 3) Minimal line-art with bold color flags. Prefers isometric for continuity with console icons.

2025-02-18 - Liam: Pulled analytics on where teams drop off in current flow (Console telemetry). High drop rate at ‘autoscale policy’ step. Suggest we add a simplified ‘starter policy’ and a hover tooltip explaining hot/cold metrics.
2025-02-22 - PM review (Sofia Morales): Prioritize mobile-safe screenshots and microcopy for legal/regulatory customers. Add copy variants for 'SLA-backed' vs 'Best-effort' tiers.

2025-02-25 - Design critique: Chosen direction = friendly isometric datacenter. Feedback: reduce visual noise in warmup stage, add latency percentile glyphs, and create a compact variant for narrow sidebars.

2025-03-01 - Eng sync (Ravi Gupta): Confirmed we can surface p99/p95 from runtime metrics for screenshots. Backend team will provide stable sample payloads for masked dashboards (shared link in attachments).
2025-03-03 - Accessibility review (Jules Park): Color contrast for purple accent fails AA at 12px. Adjust palette to meet contrast; provide high-contrast alternate illustrations.
2025-03-04 - Anya: Updated Figma file with final hero set and tooltip copy. Preparing export spec and handing off to Engineering for implementation.
decisions: Adopt friendly isometric illustration language to match Console iconography and reduce perceived complexity.
Expose a single recommended autoscale starter policy in the UI with an expandable expert view.
Include latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) in the stage visualizer; metrics will be mocked in screenshots but wired to real runtime feeds.
Create two size variants for every visual: full-width hero and compact sidebar tile.
Provide an alternate high-contrast color palette and explicit keyboard-focus states for tooltip interactions.
Mask any customer data in sample dashboards; use synthetic but realistic traces for onboarding screens.
Localize tooltip microcopy for the top three languages in our telemetry (en, de, ja) post-launch.
next_steps: Finalize export spec (SVG + PNG @2x) and annotate responsive breakpoints (Anya) - due 2025-03-07.
Produce screenshot suite with masked runtime samples and copy variants for SLA tiers (Liam) - due 2025-03-10.
Engineering implementation ticket to integrate tooltip library and sample metrics endpoint (ENG-20145) - create by 2025-03-06.
Run a short hallway usability test (5 participants) against the new flow to validate comprehension of autoscale starter policy - schedule for 2025-03-11.
Ship first-pass visuals behind feature flag for internal dogfooding and gather Console telemetry for two weeks.
review_feedback: PM (Sofia): Simplify copy for enterprise legal teams; include explicit link to compliance docs in the tooltip footer.
Eng (Ravi): Keep the tooltip animations CPU-light; prefer fade+translate over heavy particle effects.
Security (Anjali Kapoor): Ensure exported images do not leak internal IDs; maintain a canonical masking script in the repo.
Design lead (Marco Silva): Add a micro-interaction spec for the 'policy switch' with a 200ms transition and a reduced-motion variant.
